verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י קַח־ לְךָ֖ גִּלָּי֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וּכְתֹ֤ב עָלָיו֙ בְּחֶ֣רֶט אֱנ֔וֹשׁ לְמַהֵ֥ר שָׁלָ֖ל חָ֥שׁ בַּֽז׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay qaḥ- lə·ḵā gil·lā·yō·wn gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḵə·ṯōḇ ‘ā·lāw bə·ḥe·reṭ ’ĕ·nō·wōš lə·ma·hêr šā·lāl ḥāš baz
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary stylus Maher-shalal-hash-baz . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: DISSE-ME também o SENHOR: Toma um grande rolo, e escreve nele com caneta de homem: Apressando-se ao despojo, apressurou-se à presa.

verses.original: וְאָעִ֣ידָה לִּ֔י עֵדִ֖ים נֶאֱמָנִ֑ים אֵ֚ת אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־ זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ בֶּ֥ן יְבֶרֶכְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·‘î·ḏāh lî ‘ê·ḏîm ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm ’êṯ ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên wə·’eṯ- zə·ḵar·yā·hū ben yə·ḇe·reḵ·yā·hū
verses.literal: And I will appoint for Myself trustworthy witnesses Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah
verses.literalPt: Então tomei comigo fiéis testemunhas, a Urias sacerdote, e a Zacarias, filho de Jeberequias,

verses.original: וָאֶקְרַב֙ אֶל־ הַנְּבִיאָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י קְרָ֣א שְׁמ֔וֹ מַהֵ֥ר שָׁלָ֖ל חָ֥שׁ בַּֽז׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·raḇ ’el- han·nə·ḇî·’āh wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ bên way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay qə·rā šə·mōw ma·hêr šā·lāl ḥāš baz
verses.literal: And I had relations with the prophetess and she conceived and gave birth to a son The LORD said to me Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E fui ter com a profetiza, e ela concebeu, e deu à luz um filho; e o SENHOR me disse: Põe-lhe o nome de Maer-Salal-Has-Baz.

verses.original: כִּ֗י בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ יֵדַ֣ע הַנַּ֔עַר קְרֹ֖א אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֑י יִשָּׂ֣א׀ אֶת־ חֵ֣יל דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק וְאֵת֙ שְׁלַ֣ל שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לִפְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî bə·ṭe·rem yê·ḏa‘ han·na·‘ar qə·rō ’ā·ḇî wə·’im·mî yiś·śā ’eṯ- ḥêl dam·me·śeq wə·’êṯ šə·lal šō·mə·rō·wn lip̄·nê me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: For before the boy knows how to cry Father or ‘Mother the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Porque antes que o menino saiba dizer meu pai, ou minha mãe, se levarão as riquezas de Damasco, e os despojos de Samaria, diante do rei da Assíria.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣סֶף יְהוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י ע֖וֹד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ Yah·weh dab·bêr ’ê·lay ‘ō·wḏ lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD spoke to me further . . .
verses.literalPt: E continuou o SENHOR a falar ainda comigo, dizendo:

verses.original: יַ֗עַן כִּ֤י מָאַס֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֚ת מֵ֣י הַשִּׁלֹ֔חַ הַהֹלְכִ֖ים לְאַ֑ט וּמְשׂ֥וֹשׂ אֶת־ רְצִ֖ין וּבֶן־ רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an kî mā·’as hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’êṯ mê haš·ši·lō·aḥ ha·hō·lə·ḵîm lə·’aṭ ū·mə·śō·wś ’eṯ- rə·ṣîn ū·ḇen- rə·mal·yā·hū
verses.literal: Because . . . this people has rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoiced in Rezin and the son of Remaliah
verses.literalPt: Porquanto este povo desprezou as águas de Siloé que correm brandamente, e alegrou-se com Rezim e com o filho de Remalias,

verses.original: וְלָכֵ֡ן הִנֵּ֣ה אֲדֹנָי֩ מַעֲלֶ֨ה עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־ מֵ֣י הַנָּהָ֗ר הָעֲצוּמִים֙ וְהָ֣רַבִּ֔ים אֶת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כְּבוֹד֑וֹ וְעָלָה֙ עַל־ כָּל־ אֲפִיקָ֔יו וְהָלַ֖ךְ עַל־ כָּל־ גְּדוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·ḵên hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ma·‘ă·leh ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- mê han·nā·hār hā·‘ă·ṣū·mîm wə·hā·rab·bîm ’eṯ- me·leḵ ’aš·šūr wə·’eṯ- kāl- kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw wə·‘ā·lāh ‘al- kāl- ’ă·p̄î·qāw wə·hā·laḵ ‘al- kāl- gə·ḏō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: the Lord will surely bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates the king of Assyria and all his pomp It will overflow . . . . . . its channels and overrun . . . . . . its banks
verses.literalPt: Portanto eis que o Senhor fará subir sobre eles as águas do rio, fortes e impetuosas, isto é, o rei da Assíria, com toda a sua glória; e subirá sobre todos os seus leitos, e transbordará por todas as suas ribanceiras.

verses.original: וְחָלַ֤ף בִּֽיהוּדָה֙ שָׁטַ֣ף וְעָבַ֔ר עַד־ צַוָּ֖אר יַגִּ֑יעַ וְהָיָה֙ מֻטּ֣וֹת כְּנָפָ֔יו מְלֹ֥א רֹֽחַב־ אַרְצְךָ֖ עִמָּ֥נוּ אֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·lap̄ bî·hū·ḏāh šā·ṭap̄ wə·‘ā·ḇar ‘aḏ- ṣaw·wār yag·gî·a‘ wə·hā·yāh muṭ·ṭō·wṯ kə·nā·p̄āw mə·lō rō·ḥaḇ- ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ‘im·mā·nū ’êl
verses.literal: It will pour into Judah swirling and sweeping over it reaching . . . up to the neck its spreading streams . . . will cover your entire land O Immanuel
verses.literalPt: E passará a Judá, inundando-o, e irá passando por ele e chegará até ao pescoço; e a extensão de suas asas encherá a largura da tua terra, ó Emanuel.

verses.original: רֹ֤עוּ עַמִּים֙ וָחֹ֔תּוּ וְהַֽאֲזִ֔ינוּ כֹּ֖ל מֶרְחַקֵּי־ אָ֑רֶץ הִתְאַזְּר֣וּ וָחֹ֔תּוּ הִֽתְאַזְּר֖וּ וָחֹֽתּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·‘ū ‘am·mîm wā·ḥōt·tū wə·ha·’ă·zî·nū kōl mer·ḥaq·qê- ’ā·reṣ hiṯ·’az·zə·rū wā·ḥōt·tū hiṯ·’az·zə·rū wā·ḥōt·tū
verses.literal: Huddle together O peoples and be shattered pay attention all you distant lands prepare for battle and be shattered prepare for battle and be shattered
verses.literalPt: Ajuntai-vos, ó povos, e sereis quebrantados; dai ouvidos, todos os que sois de terras longínquas; cingi-vos e sereis feitos em pedaços, cingi-vos e sereis feitos em pedaços.

verses.original: עֻ֥צוּ עֵצָ֖ה וְתֻפָ֑ר דַּבְּר֤וּ דָבָר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָק֔וּם כִּ֥י עִמָּ֖נוּ אֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘u·ṣū ‘ê·ṣāh wə·ṯu·p̄ār dab·bə·rū ḏā·ḇār wə·lō yā·qūm kî ‘im·mā·nū ’êl
verses.literal: Devise a plan but it will be thwarted state a proposal but it will not happen For God is with us
verses.literalPt: Tomai juntamente conselho, e ele será frustrado; dizei uma palavra, e ela não subsistirá, porque Deus é conosco.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י כְּחֶזְקַ֣ת הַיָּ֑ד וְיִסְּרֵ֕נִי מִלֶּ֛כֶת בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ê·lay kə·ḥez·qaṯ hay·yāḏ wə·yis·sə·rê·nî mil·le·ḵeṯ bə·ḏe·reḵ hā·‘ām- haz·zeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD has spoken to me with a strong hand instructing me not to walk in the way of this . . . people
verses.literalPt: Porque assim o SENHOR me disse com mão forte, e me ensinou que não andasse pelo caminho deste povo, dizendo:

verses.original: לֹא־ תֹאמְר֣וּן קֶ֔שֶׁר לְכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֹאמַ֛ר הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה קָ֑שֶׁר וְאֶת־ מוֹרָא֥וֹ לֹֽא־ תִֽירְא֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תַעֲרִֽיצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯō·mə·rūn qe·šer lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yō·mar hā·‘ām haz·zeh qā·šer wə·’eṯ- mō·w·rā·’ōw lō- ṯî·rə·’ū wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·rî·ṣū
verses.literal: Do not call conspiracy everything these people regard as conspiracy Do not fear what they fear do not live in dread
verses.literalPt: Não chameis conjuração, a tudo quanto este povo chama conjuração; e não temais o que ele teme, nem tampouco vos assombreis.

verses.original: אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֹת֣וֹ תַקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ וְה֥וּא מוֹרַאֲכֶ֖ם וְה֥וּא מַֽעֲרִֽצְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ō·ṯōw ṯaq·dî·šū wə·hū mō·w·ra·’ă·ḵem wə·hū ma·‘ă·riṣ·ḵem
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts is the One you shall regard as holy Only He should be feared only He should be dreaded
verses.literalPt: Ao SENHOR dos Exércitos, a ele santificai; e seja ele o vosso temor e seja ele o vosso assombro.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה לְמִקְדָּ֑שׁ וּלְאֶ֣בֶן נֶ֠גֶף וּלְצ֨וּר מִכְשׁ֜וֹל לִשְׁנֵ֨י בָתֵּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְפַ֣ח וּלְמוֹקֵ֔שׁ לְיוֹשֵׁ֖ב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·miq·dāš ū·lə·’e·ḇen ne·ḡep̄ ū·lə·ṣūr miḵ·šō·wl liš·nê ḇāt·tê yiś·rā·’êl lə·p̄aḥ ū·lə·mō·w·qêš lə·yō·wō·šêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And He will be a sanctuary but to both houses of Israel a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense to the dwellers of Jerusalem a trap and a snare
verses.literalPt: Então ele vos será por santuário; mas servirá de pedra de tropeço, e rocha de escândalo, às duas casas de Israel; por armadilha e laço aos moradores de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְכָ֥שְׁלוּ בָ֖ם רַבִּ֑ים וְנָפְל֣וּ וְנִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְנוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְנִלְכָּֽדוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·šə·lū ḇām rab·bîm wə·nā·p̄ə·lū wə·niš·bā·rū wə·nō·wq·šū wə·nil·kā·ḏū
verses.literal: Many will stumble over these they will fall and be broken they will be ensnared and captured
verses.literalPt: E muitos entre eles tropeçarão, e cairão, e serão quebrantados, e enlaçados, e presos.

verses.original: צ֖וֹר תְּעוּדָ֑ה חֲת֥וֹם תּוֹרָ֖ה בְּלִמֻּדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ṣō·wr tə·‘ū·ḏāh ḥă·ṯō·wm tō·w·rāh bə·lim·mu·ḏāy
verses.literal: Bind up the testimony and seal the law among my disciples
verses.literalPt: Liga o testemunho, sela a lei entre os meus discípulos.

verses.original: וְחִכִּ֙יתִי֙ לַיהוָ֔ה הַמַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנָ֖יו מִבֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְקִוֵּ֖יתִֽי־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥik·kî·ṯî Yah·weh ham·mas·tîr pā·nāw mib·bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·qiw·wê·ṯî- lōw
verses.literal: I will wait for the LORD who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob I will put my trust in Him
verses.literalPt: E esperarei ao SENHOR, que esconde o seu rosto da casa de Jacó, e a ele aguardarei.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֗י וְהַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָֽתַן־ לִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְאֹת֥וֹת וּלְמוֹפְתִ֖ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵעִם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הַשֹּׁכֵ֖ן בְּהַ֥ר צִיּֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·hay·lā·ḏîm ’ă·šer nā·ṯan- lî Yah·weh lə·’ō·ṯō·wṯ ū·lə·mō·wp̄·ṯîm bə·yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘im Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ haš·šō·ḵên bə·har ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Here am I and the children the LORD has given me as signs and symbols in Israel from the LORD of Hosts who dwells on Mount Zion
verses.literalPt: Eis-me aqui, com os filhos que me deu o SENHOR, por sinais e por maravilhas em Israel, da parte do SENHOR dos Exércitos, que habita no monte de Sião.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יֹאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵיכֶ֗ם דִּרְשׁ֤וּ אֶל־ הָאֹבוֹת֙ וְאֶל־ הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים הַֽמְצַפְצְפִ֖ים וְהַמַּהְגִּ֑ים הֲלוֹא־ עַם֙ אֶל־ אֱלֹהָ֣יו יִדְרֹ֔שׁ בְּעַ֥ד הַחַיִּ֖ים אֶל־ הַמֵּתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·ḵem dir·šū ’el- hā·’ō·ḇō·wṯ wə·’el- hay·yid·də·‘ō·nîm ham·ṣap̄·ṣə·p̄îm wə·ham·mah·gîm hă·lō·w- ‘am ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hāw yiḏ·rōš bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥay·yîm ’el- ham·mê·ṯîm
verses.literal: When men tell you to consult . . . mediums . . . and spiritists who whisper and mutter shouldn’t a people . . . consult their God instead Why consult the dead on behalf of the living . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, vos disserem: Consultai os que têm espíritos familiares e os adivinhos, que chilreiam e murmuram: Porventura não consultará o povo a seu Deus? A favor dos vivos consultar-se-á aos mortos?

verses.original: לְתוֹרָ֖ה וְלִתְעוּדָ֑ה אִם־ לֹ֤א יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ כַּדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ ל֖וֹ שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ṯō·w·rāh wə·liṯ·‘ū·ḏāh ’im- lō yō·mə·rū kad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’ă·šer ’ên- lōw šā·ḥar
verses.literal: To the law and to the testimony If they do not speak according to this word they have no light of dawn
verses.literalPt: À lei e ao testemunho! Se eles não falarem segundo esta palavra, é porque não há luz neles.

verses.original: וְעָ֥בַר בָּ֖הּ נִקְשֶׁ֣ה וְרָעֵ֑ב וְהָיָ֨ה כִֽי־ יִרְעַ֜ב וְהִתְקַצַּ֗ף וְקִלֵּ֧ל בְּמַלְכּ֛וֹ וּבֵאלֹהָ֖יו וּפָנָ֥ה לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar bāh niq·šeh wə·rā·‘êḇ wə·hā·yāh ḵî- yir·‘aḇ wə·hiṯ·qaṣ·ṣap̄ wə·qil·lêl bə·mal·kōw ū·ḇê·lō·hāw ū·p̄ā·nāh lə·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: They will roam the land dejected and hungry . . . When they are famished they will become enraged and looking upward they will curse their king and their God
verses.literalPt: E passarão pela terra duramente oprimidos e famintos; e será que, tendo fome, e enfurecendo-se, então amaldiçoarão ao seu rei e ao seu Deus, olhando para cima.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ אֶ֖רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט וְהִנֵּ֨ה צָרָ֤ה וַחֲשֵׁכָה֙ מְע֣וּף צוּקָ֔ה וַאֲפֵלָ֖ה מְנֻדָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- ’e·reṣ yab·bîṭ wə·hin·nêh ṣā·rāh wa·ḥă·šê·ḵāh mə·‘ūp̄ ṣū·qāh wa·’ă·p̄ê·lāh mə·nud·dāḥ
verses.literal: Then they will look to the earth and see only distress and darkness and the gloom of anguish And they will be driven into utter darkness
verses.literalPt: E, olhando para a terra, eis que haverá angústia e escuridão, e sombras de ansiedade, e serão empurrados para as trevas.
